**Best value: ALLPOWERS P1800 + 400 W panel kit** — listed at **$698** for a 1,024 Wh LiFePO₄ battery, 1,800 W inverter, and a relatively substantial 400 W panel. That’s a strong package for keeping essentials like phones, lights, a router, and some small appliances running. **The catch: it’s a preorder**, so it may not suit an outage you need to prepare for immediately. [Check the kit and current availability](https://dealectric.com/go/allpowers-p1800-sp037-solar-kit).

**If you need one sooner:** consider the **BLUETTI AC180 + 200 W panel kit**, listed at $729 (or $692.55 with the code shown in the listing). [Check the kit](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-ac180-200w-solar-kit). It’s also identified as a home-backup pick in this [under-$1,000 roundup](https://www.wpa-pool.com/best-solar-generators-under-1000/).

Neither is whole-home backup: around 1 kWh of stored energy is better for selected essentials than heating, central air, or other heavy loads. [See the kit comparison](https://dealectric.com/best-solar-generator-kit-under-1000-for-home-backup) and [what this size can realistically run](https://www.haynet.net/best-solar-generators-under-1000-dollars/).
